cashFlowClassification.title: Cash Flow Classification
cashFlowClassification.intro: Tag each cash flow as external contribution, internal transfer, or income reinvested. External contributions feed the North Star glide-path run-rate. Unclassified flows mean the run-rate is pending.
cashFlowClassification.orphanedTagsWarning_one: {{count}} tag reference transactions that were re-imported — re-run Auto-classify to re-derive internal transfers, re-tag externals manually.
cashFlowClassification.orphanedTagsWarning_other: {{count}} tags reference transactions that were re-imported — re-run Auto-classify to re-derive internal transfers, re-tag externals manually.
cashFlowClassification.fsCashDeltaHint: Financial-Summary cash accounts appear here as monthly balance changes — tag each as a deposit (external), spending, or transfer. For USD accounts the change includes FX movement, not just cash flow.
cashFlowClassification.emptyUnclassified: No unclassified flows — all flows have been tagged.
cashFlowClassification.emptyClassified: No classified flows yet. Use Auto-classify or tag flows individually.
cashFlowClassification.orphanedTitle: This tag's transaction was re-imported with a different identity (or no longer exists). Untag it, then re-run Auto-classify or re-tag manually.
